role: XCTest suite for SessionArchive storage integrity on a private temp directory: archive/retrieve, SHA256 hash, duplicates, re-upload notifications and modifiedAt stamping, trash, deletion, tags, concurrency, batch archive, integrity verification, encrypted repair, nearby-session detection and edge cases.
types: ArchiveIntegrityTests: class — XCTestCase over a hermetic SessionArchive (more tests in ArchiveIntegrityTests+Codec.swift)
state: mem:ArchiveIntegrityTests.archive (lazy SessionArchive with injected 22:00/8h schedule, .defaultGap merge mode, 4.5h merge gap)
toplevel: archiveDirectory is a per-instance temp URL; archive is a lazy SessionArchive(directory:archiveDirectory, schedule 22:00+8h, mergeMode .defaultGap, mergeGap 4.5h) so tests do not depend on SettingsManager. Class setUp pins NSTimeZone.default to UTC and warms static singletons.

units.does: Class setUp: saves NSTimeZone.default, pins it to UTC, and touches DebugLogger.shared, EncryptionManager.shared and the four SessionArchive static coders single-threaded so concurrent tests cannot deadlock on dispatch_once.

units.does: Class tearDown: restores the saved default time zone and clears the saved value.

branches.effect: restores it; otherwise leaves NSTimeZone.default unchanged

flags.text: The archive directory is hermetic but delete() also records each deleted id in process-wide UserDefaults.standard["archive.deletionTimes"]; every teardown (and testDeletion / testDeletedSessionIsKeptWholeInTheTrash) adds test UUIDs to the app host's real key, which nothing removes.
